doc:
# Basic — Complexity

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “holographic complexity”).

claims.name: large_volume_limit_holographic_complexity
claims.statement: In large volume limit, holographic complexity reduces to holographic information metric.

claims.name: holographic_complexity_investigated_eternal_black
claims.statement: Holographic complexity is investigated for eternal black hole backgrounds perturbed by shock waves using both complexity=action (CA) and complexity=volume (CV) proposals

sources.title: Holographic Complexity in Vaidya Spacetimes II

claims.name: complexity_superadditive_holographic_settings_while
claims.statement: Complexity is superadditive in holographic settings while subadditive in free scalar QFT using diagonal basis.

sources.title: Complexity of Mixed States in QFT and Holography

claims.name: holographic_definition_complexity_independent_orientation
claims.statement: The holographic definition of complexity is independent of the orientation of time on the boundary.

claims.name: possible_relation_exists_between_holographic
claims.statement: A possible relation exists between holographic complexity and fidelity from quantum-information literature.

claims.name: show_framework_also_encompasses_nicely
claims.statement: We show that this framework also encompasses nicely the holographic notions of complexity.

sources.title: A universal approach to Krylov State and Operator complexities

claims.name: infinite_volume_limit_holographic_complexity
claims.statement: In infinite volume limit, holographic complexity reduces to fidelity susceptibility.

claims.name: quantum_state_black_hole_interior
claims.statement: The quantum state of a black hole interior has a growing complexity that is dual to the growing spacetime volume behind the horizon, equal at any instant to the Einstein-Hilbert action of the Wheeler-DeWitt patch anchored at boundary time t.

sources.title: The Second Law of Quantum Complexity

claims.name: holographic_complexity_contains_universal_term
claims.statement: Holographic complexity contains a universal term independent of the UV cutoff for arbitrary $d$.

claims.name: universal_terms_holographic_complexity_independent
claims.statement: Universal terms of holographic complexity are independent of subsystem size and may reflect intrinsic properties of the theory, potentially analogous to central charge.

claims.name: quantum_computational_complexity_was_suggested
claims.statement: Quantum computational complexity was suggested as a new entry in the holographic dictionary, extending the connection between geometry and information.

sources.title: Quantum Computational Complexity -- From Quantum Information to Black Holes and Back

claims.name: find_complexity_subregions_subadditive_comment
claims.statement: We find that the complexity of subregions is subadditive, and comment on potential implications for holography.

sources.title: Complexity as a novel probe of quantum quenches: universal scalings and purifications

claims.name: holographic_complexity_subsystem_proportional_volume
claims.statement: Holographic complexity for a subsystem is proportional to the volume of a co-dimension one time slice in the bulk geometry enclosed by the extremal co-dimension two hyper-surface from holographic entanglement entropy computation.

claims.name: complexity_growth_holographic_states_dual
claims.statement: The complexity growth of holographic states dual to charged black holes in AdS space can be calculated by analyzing charged black holes with a single horizon

sources.title: Action growth of charged black holes with a single horizon

claims.name: evolution_quantum_complexity_growth_geometry
claims.statement: The evolution of quantum complexity and the growth of the geometry behind black hole horizons follow identical patterns.

claims.name: find_holographic_complexity_corresponding_growth
claims.statement: We find that holographic complexity and corresponding growth rate presents universal behaviour for all three approaches.

claims.name: propose_quantum_complexity_boundary_state
claims.statement: We propose that the quantum complexity of the boundary state is equal to the classical action of a spacetime region that extends deep inside the horizon.

claims.name: holographic_complexity_sensitive_boundary_terms
claims.statement: Holographic complexity is sensitive to boundary terms at unobserved internal boundaries: an internal boundary term inadvertently introduced in integrating out the gauge field from RN to JT explains the discrepancy in complexity growth between JT and RN.

sources.title: The Case of the Missing Gates: Complexity of Jackiw-Teitelboim Gravity
